DESCRIPTION.Locations: Directories used by the router configuration utility.
DESCRIPTION.Locations.config_path: Directory containing original router backup files.
DESCRIPTION.Locations.model_specs_path: Directory containing router model JSON specifications. Add another router by creating a new JSON file here.
DESCRIPTION.Locations.decoded_config_path: Directory containing decoded router archives and extracted configurations.
DESCRIPTION.Locations.edited_config_path: Directory containing edited copies of router configurations.
DESCRIPTION.Locations.updated_config_path: Directory containing newly encoded router backup files.
